notes: favor/disfavor = keywords matched against condition_name_en (lowercase). always = asked every time by code (safety). red_flag = route to urgent care. refer = recommend a physiotherapist in person.

elbow.text_zh: 甚麼動作會令痛楚加劇？

options.en: Gripping or lifting with my palm facing down
Bending my wrist down, throwing, or a golf swing
options.zh: 向下屈手腕、擲東西或揮高爾夫球桿

elbow.text_en: Do you have numbness or tingling in your fingers?
elbow.text_zh: 手指有麻痺或刺痛感嗎？

options.en: Front, around or behind the kneecap
options.zh: 前面，膝蓋骨周圍或後面

options.en: Deep inside, or the whole knee
With a twist, sudden turn or awkward landing
options.zh: 扭傷、急轉身或落地不穩時開始
隨跑步或運動逐漸出現

knee.text_en: Does your knee lock, catch or give way?
knee.text_zh: 膝蓋會卡住、彈響或突然發軟嗎？

options.en: It gives way or feels unstable
options.zh: 會突然發軟或感覺不穩

knee.text_en: Did your knee swell up within a few hours of an injury?
knee.text_zh: 受傷後數小時內膝蓋有腫起嗎？

shoulder.text_en: Is the pain linked with chest pain, shortness of breath or sweating?
shoulder.text_zh: 痛楚有否伴隨胸口痛、呼吸困難或冒汗？

shoulder.text_en: Which best describes the problem when you move your arm?
shoulder.text_zh: 活動手臂時，以下哪項最貼切？

options.en: Painful partway through lifting my arm, easier higher up
options.zh: 舉手到一半時痛，再舉高反而舒緩

options.en: Weak or painful when lifting or reaching behind
options.zh: 舉手或向後伸時無力或痛

options.en: Very stiff in all directions, even when someone else moves it
options.zh: 各方向都很僵硬，即使別人幫我移動也一樣
逐漸開始，幾星期內越來越僵硬

options.en: After a fall, lifting something heavy or sport
options.zh: 跌倒、提重物或運動後開始
重複舉手過頭的活動後開始

shoulder.text_en: Does it wake you at night, especially lying on that side?
shoulder.text_zh: 晚上會痛醒嗎？特別是側睡壓著那邊時？

lower back.text_en: Any numbness around your groin or buttocks, or new trouble passing urine?
lower back.text_zh: 下體或臀部周圍有麻痺，或最近開始排尿困難嗎？

lower back.text_en: Does the pain travel down your leg?

options.en: No, it stays in my back or buttock
Into my thigh, above the knee
Below the knee, into my calf or foot
options.zh: 延伸到膝蓋以下、小腿或腳

lower back.text_en: Any numbness, tingling or weakness in your legs?
lower back.text_zh: 腳部有麻痺、刺痛或無力嗎？

upper back.text_en: Is the pain worse when breathing deeply, or linked with chest pain?
upper back.text_zh: 深呼吸時會更痛，或伴隨胸口痛嗎？

upper back.text_en: Does the pain also involve your neck?
Is it worse after long periods at a desk or on your phone?
upper back.text_zh: 長時間用電腦或手機後會更痛嗎？

neck.text_en: Did it start after a car accident, fall or sudden jolt?
neck.text_zh: 痛楚是在交通意外、跌倒或突然撞擊後開始的嗎？

neck.text_en: Is it worse after looking down at your phone or screen?
neck.text_zh: 低頭看手機或螢幕後會更痛嗎？

neck.text_en: Does pain, numbness or tingling travel into your arm or hand?
neck.text_zh: 痛楚、麻痺或刺痛會延伸到手臂或手掌嗎？

wrist.text_en: Did it start after a fall onto your hand?
wrist.text_zh: 痛楚是在跌倒時用手撐地後開始的嗎？

wrist.text_en: Do you have numbness or tingling in your thumb, index or middle finger?
wrist.text_zh: 拇指、食指或中指有麻痺或刺痛感嗎？

wrist.text_en: Is it worse at night, or does it wake you up?

options.en: Groin or front of the hip

hip.text_en: Does it hurt to lie on that side?
hip.text_zh: 側睡壓著那邊時會痛嗎？

ankle.text_en: Can you put weight on that foot and take 4 steps?
ankle.text_zh: 你能用那隻腳承重並行走四步嗎？

ankle.text_en: Did it start after rolling or twisting your ankle?
ankle.text_zh: 痛楚是在扭傷腳踝（拗柴）後開始的嗎？

options.en: Back of the heel, or just above it

foot.text_en: Did you feel a sudden snap, or as if someone kicked the back of your ankle?
foot.text_zh: 你有否突然感到「啪」一聲，或好像被人踢中腳跟後面？

foot.text_en: Is it worst with your first steps in the morning?
foot.text_zh: 早上起床踏出頭幾步時最痛嗎？

options.en: Back of the heel, or just above it
